主要内容: On February 11, 2020, Insperity, Inc. issued a press release announcing the company’s financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2019. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The company is a business services company registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission under the name Insperity, Inc. and ticker symbol NSP. The press release provides details on the company’s financial and operating performance for the specified periods. The information is relevant to the company’s financial condition and operations, and it is intended for disclosure under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The press release is part of the company’s regular reporting obligations and is not intended to predict future performance or market movements.
